bio.text: Eric Burlison was elected in 2022 to represent Missouri's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He previously represented the 20th Senatorial District in the Missouri Senate from 2019 to 2023, and before that the 133rd District in the Missouri House of Representatives.
He worked for 20 years as an investment advisor and software consultant, and earned a B.A. in Philosophy and an MBA from Missouri State University.
